especially.en: Under this system, Poland had to rebuild, and especially they had to rebuild Warsaw.
especially.zh: 在这种体制下，波兰必须进行重建，特别是他们必须重建华沙。

especially.en: Another major success is economic growth and development, especially in newer members like Poland.
especially.zh: 另一个重大的成功是经济增长和发展，特别是在像波兰这样较新的成员国中。

especially.en: Diseases, especially smallpox, which was brought from Europe, spread through the city, killing thousands.
especially.zh: 疾病（尤其是从欧洲带过去的天花）在城中蔓延，夺去了成千上万人的生命。

especially.en: Metabolism refers to the chemical processes inside your body, especially those which process food.
especially.zh: Metabolism指的是你体内的化学过程，尤其是那些处理食物的过程。

especially.en: When you combine talent with advantage and especially skill, it makes up your overall ability.
especially.zh: 当你把天赋与优势、尤其是技能结合起来时，它就构成了你的整体能力。

establish.en: Most of these colonies had been established during the 1600s, maybe the early 1700s.
establish.zh: 这些殖民地大多是在17世纪或18世纪初建立的。

establish.en: They think a lot about history, and they follow established ways of doing things.
establish.zh: 遵循你们的风俗，遵循你们的传统。

establish.en: The first dates from 1670, when the principle of jury nullification was established in England.
establish.zh: 第一个案例要追溯到1670年，那一年，"陪审团废止权"这项原则在英格兰被正式确立。

establish.en: They built castles, established new centres of power, and reshaped many Irish towns.
establish.zh: 他们建造城堡，建立新的权力中心，并重塑了许多爱尔兰城镇。

establish.en: And his wartime code breaking helped establish modern approaches to information security.
establish.zh: 而他战时的密码破译工作则确立了现代信息安全的方法论。

estate.en: Ryan spent months living in a low-income housing estate, which he gave the fictional name Woldham.
estate.zh: 瑞安在一个低收入住宅区生活了几个月，他给这个住宅区起了个虚构的名字叫沃尔德姆。

estate.en: Some believe it might have been a royal estate for an Incan emperor.
estate.zh: 有些人认为它可能是印加皇帝的皇家庄园。

estate.en: Estate agents increasingly encouraged prospective buyers to think not about the sale price, but rather the monthly mortgage payments.
estate.zh: 房地产中介越来越鼓励潜在买家不要去想售价，而是去关注每月的房贷还款额。

estate.en: So when an Irish lord agreed to " surrender and regrant," he was unknowingly converting his clan 's shared land into his own private estate under English law.
estate.zh: 因此，当一位爱尔兰领主同意“投降与重授”时，他是在不知不觉中根据英国法律将氏族的共有土地变成了他自己的私有财产。

estate.en: Catholic landowners lost their estates. Those who survived were ordered west of the River Shannon — to Connacht, the western province of Ireland, the most remote and poorest part of the island.
estate.zh: 天主教地主失去了他们的庄园。幸存者被命令迁往香农河（River Shannon）以西——前往爱尔兰西部的康诺特（Connacht）省，那是岛上最偏远、最贫困的地方。

essential.en: With very limited land and very limited resources, cooperation across the island was essential.
essential.zh: 在土地和资源都非常有限的情况下，全岛的合作至关重要。

essential.en: If they continued to protest, they were told "It is absolutely essential that you continue."
essential.zh: 如果对方继续抗议，他们会被告知：“你必须继续，这是绝对必要的。”

essential.en: The adverb inherently describes something that exists in a way which is natural or essential.
essential.zh: 副词“本质上”描述的是以一种自然或必不可少的方式存在的事物。

essential.en: That feedback is essential. Otherwise, you might be repeating mistakes instead of improving.
essential.zh: 这种反馈至关重要。否则，你可能是在重复错误，而不是在进步。

essential.en: The adverb inherently describes something that exists in a way which is natural or essential.
essential.zh: 副词“本质上”描述的是以一种自然或必不可少的方式存在的事物。

estimate.en: But with around 65% of British adults estimated to be overweight, that doesn't help everyone.
estimate.zh: 但据估计，大约有 65% 的英国成年人超重，所以这并不能帮到所有人。

estimate.en: In its heyday, there were an estimated 400 Punch men, or professors, in Britain.
estimate.zh: 在其鼎盛时期，英国估计有 400 名 Punch 艺人或“教授”。

estimate.en: Historians estimate that roughly 40% of all Africans transported across the Atlantic arrived in Brazil.
estimate.zh: 历史学家估计，所有横渡大西洋被运送的非洲人中，大约有40%到达了巴西。

estimate.en: Indeed, in 1970, he is estimated to have stolen 60% of the entire country’s annual budget.
estimate.zh: 事实上，据估计，仅在1970年他就盗用了全国年度预算的60%。

estimate.en: According to global estimates, around 700 to 760 million people worldwide still live in absolute poverty.
estimate.zh: 根据全球估计，全球仍有大约7.00亿至7.60亿人生活在绝对贫困中。

escape.en: Another nine were seriously injured, and the remaining eleven escaped with minor injuries.
escape.zh: 另有九人重伤，其余十一人受轻伤。

escape.en: Well, Georgie, I asked you which animals escaped from a zoo in Sydney, Australia, in 2022.
escape.zh: 嗯，乔治，我问过你2022年哪种动物从澳大利亚悉尼的动物园逃跑了。

escape.en: The learner would be strapped into a chair with electrical wiring so they couldn't escape.
escape.zh: “学生”会被绑在一张接有电线的椅子上，无法逃脱。

escape.en: Luckily for him, and for our story, he managed to escape from jail, and skipped town.
escape.zh: 幸运的是——对他本人，也对我们这个故事来说——他成功越狱并逃离了小镇。

escape.en: Each problem reinforces the next, making escape from the poverty trap difficult.
escape.zh: 每个问题都在加剧下一个问题，使得摆脱贫困陷阱变得困难重重。

establishment.en: They work within the system. They have a career to protect and professional instincts shaped by years inside the legal establishment.
establishment.zh: 他们在这个体制内工作，有自己的职业生涯需要维护，也有经年累月在法律体系内培养出的职业本能。

establishment.en: This was just over a month into the establishment of DOGE, the Department of Governmental Efficiency, and was one of its most controversial acts.
establishment.zh: 这发生在 DOGE（政府效率部）成立一个多月后，是其最具争议的行为之一。

establishment.en: A few months later, on the 29th of October 1923, he declared the establishment of the Republic of Turkey, the Republic of Türkiye, to give it its correct modern name.
establishment.zh: 几个月后，即1923年10月29日，他宣布成立土耳其共和国（Republic of Türkiye，使用其正确的现代名称）。

essay.en: In 1858, a young naturalist named Alfred Russell Wallace sent Darwin an essay.
essay.zh: 1858年，一位名叫Alfred Russell Wallace的年轻博物学家给Darwin寄了一篇论文。

essay.en: John Locke had recently published his famous Essay Concerning Human Understanding.
essay.zh: John Locke 最近刚出版了他著名的《人类理解论》。

essay.en: Or maybe you remember essay structures, you remember phrases, you remember a system of writing specifically for a test.
essay.zh: 或者也许你记住了议论文结构、记住了短语、记住了专门针对考试的写作体系。

essay.en: You fail an exam, or you have a bad performance in a conversation, or you write a essay which your teacher says is not very good, and you take that as a judgment on your ability.
essay.zh: 你考试不及格，或者在对话中表现不佳，或者写了一篇老师说不太好的论文，你就会把这当作对你能力的一场审判。
